subtitle: So your Thursday number matches your Monday number.

code:
a = np.random.default_rng(42).normal(size=3)
b = np.random.default_rng(42).normal(size=3)
c = np.random.default_rng().normal(size=3)

np.array_equal(a, b)   # True  (same seed)
np.array_equal(c, np.random.default_rng().normal(size=3))  # False
caption: Same seed, same sequence. 42 has no special meaning — pick any integer and keep it.

code:
import hashlib
fingerprint = hashlib.sha256(RAW.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
# 64-character fingerprint of the file's exact bytes
caption: One changed character changes the fingerprint — proof of exactly which data version produced a result.
